name: Image generation
description: Turn a prompt into illustrations, product images and game assets
example: a tiny glass greenhouse on a floating island, warm sunlight, detailed illustration
commercial_note: Images can be used in products, advertising and games, subject to the OpenRAIL-M use restrictions.

name: Music generation
description: Describe a mood and instruments to create background music or songs
vram: 8GB target · CPU offload · language generation disabled
example: instrumental, chill lo-fi hip hop, soft piano, warm bass, rainy evening, 90 BPM
commercial_note: The official model card permits commercial use of generated music. Check rights to supplied lyrics and reference material separately.

name: Video generation
description: Describe motion to create a short silent video
example: A small paper boat gently floats on a calm pond, sunlight reflecting on the water, steady cinematic camera.
commercial_note: Uses an Apache-2.0 model. Preserve original licenses and required notices when redistributing models or code.

name: Image to 3D
description: Create colored GLB and OBJ assets from a single object image
commercial_note: Uses an MIT model. Create 3D assets from images you have the right to use commercially.

name: Background removal
description: Keep the subject and save a transparent PNG
vram: Runs on CPU · no GPU memory required
commercial_note: You must have commercial rights to the input photo. Removing its background does not change those rights.
